title: The Tree of Human Thought
page_title: The Tree of Human Thought — who shaped whom
tagline: An influence-genealogy of ideas across history — who shaped whom, from the evidence horizon of writing to now. Thinkers placed by era and domain; the documented record in gray, the cross-tradition bridges in amber.
card_question: Every thought you have was handed to you. Who handed it down?
source: Wikidata influence graph · plus a cited, authored branch for the traditions the record under-documents
discussion_prompt: Whose line did you find yourself standing in?
